alert_news.title: Two female leopards sterilised in India's first such initiative
bullets: India's first immunocontraception-based leopard sterilisation program launched by Junnar forest division, Pune, Maharashtra, under MoEFCC.
Two female leopards vaccinated and released, pilot aims to control population through non‑lethal, reversible method, first such initiative in India.

alert_news.title: Aaka Space plans India's first underwater human spaceflight analog mission in Gujarat
bullets: India's first underwater human spaceflight analog mission to be conducted by Aaka Space, Gujarat, simulating spaceflight conditions for astronaut training.
24‑hour trial scheduled for December 2026, followed by 72‑hour mission in March 2027, in partnership with ISRO and Indian Navy.

alert_news.title: India's First Multi-Purpose Vessel INS Samarthak Commissioned
bullets: INS Samarthak, India’s first multi‑purpose vessel (MPV), commissioned at Karwar naval base, built by a private shipyard

75% indigenous content; serves as mothership for unmanned and autonomous surface and aerial vehicles, testbed for weapons and sensors, platform for maritime surveillance, towing, disaster relief and hospital ship

alert_news.title: ISRO completes critical separation tests for Gaganyaan mission
bullets: India’s first human spaceflight mission, Gaganyaan, has completed CM‑SM separation tests at VSSC, Thiruvananthapuram.
The tests validate the crew module’s separation system, including pyrotechnic devices and umbilical jettisoning, ahead of the uncrewed launch targeted for end‑2026.

alert_news.title: Ladakh's Development Momentum
bullets: India’s first geothermal‑heating passenger terminal at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh, built for ₹640 cr.
India’s first Petroglyph Conservation Park at Sindhu Ghat, Ladakh, protecting ancient rock art.
A 298‑km Nimmu‑Padum‑Darcha road by the Border Roads Organisation enhances all‑weather connectivity.

alert_news.title: India's First Geothermal‑Powered Passenger Terminal at Leh Airport
bullets: India's first passenger terminal to use geothermal heating, located at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh, built for Rs 640 crore
India's first Petroglyph Conservation Park established at Sindhu Ghat, safeguarding ancient rock‑art heritage

alert_news.title: ISRO's AstroSat Uncovers Cosmic Mysteries, Delivers Breakthrough Insights Into the Universe
bullets: India’s first dedicated multi‑wavelength space observatory – AstroSat, launched by ISRO on 28 Sep 2015 from Satish Dhawan Space Centre.
Capable of simultaneous observations in ultraviolet, visible and X‑ray bands, enabling comprehensive studies of cosmic sources.
Designed for a 5‑year mission life, it has continued operating beyond its planned lifespan, marking a milestone in Indian space science.

alert_news.title: Aster CMI Hospital Performs India's First Paediatric Kidney Transplant Through Donor Swap
bullets: India’s first paediatric kidney transplant performed via donor‑paired exchange – 15‑year‑old boy and 21‑year‑old man at Aster CMI Hospital, Bengaluru.
Utilised donor‑matching software from the Alliance for Paired Donation to overcome blood‑group incompatibility.
First such procedure in India, expanding transplant options for children with incompatible donors.

alert_news.title: India's First Human Spaceflight Mission – Gaganyaan Separation Tests
bullets: India’s first human spaceflight mission, Gaganyaan, undergoing critical Crew Module–Service Module (CM‑SM) separation tests at VSSC to ensure astronaut safety.
Tests validate pyrotechnic separation systems and shock survivability of key subsystems, paving the way for the planned launch by the end of 2026.

alert_news.title: Aditya-L1 and Proba-3 Study Solar Eruptions
bullets: Aditya‑L1 is India’s first dedicated solar mission, launched by ISRO on 2 September 2023 and entered a halo orbit around the Sun–Earth L1 point on 6 January 2024.
The spacecraft carries the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) to observe the solar corona and study coronal mass ejections and solar flares.

alert_news.title: India's first private-built warship INS Samarthak commissioned into Navy
bullets: First major warship built by a private shipyard (L&T) and commissioned into the Indian Navy, marking a milestone in indigenous warship construction.
Built at L&T's Kattupalli shipyard, Tamil Nadu, with over 75% indigenous content, serving as a multi‑purpose vessel for surveillance, weapons trials, and unmanned systems.

alert_news.title: Aditya‑L1: India’s First Dedicated Solar Mission
bullets: Aditya‑L1 is India’s first dedicated solar mission, launched by ISRO on 2 September 2023 and entered a halo orbit around the Sun–Earth L1 point on 6 January 2024.
The spacecraft carries the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) to observe the solar corona and study coronal mass ejections and solar flares.
It enabled the first Indian observations of pre‑flare brightenings and detailed spectroscopic signatures of CME onset.

alert_news.title: Mormugao Port Secures India’s First Private 5G Network Authorisation
bullets: Mormugao Port Authority (MPA) became India’s first major port and government autonomous body to obtain authorisation for a captive non‑public network (CNPN) to deploy a private 5G network.
The authorisation, granted by the Department of Telecommunications in September 2026 under the Telecommunications Act 2023, is valid for 20 years.
The network will support smart port operations, automated logistics, cargo tracking, real‑time monitoring, drone surveillance and smart sensors.

alert_news.title: India’s first airport terminal with geothermal heating inaugurated in Leh
bullets: Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport passenger terminal in Leh is India's first airport terminal equipped with geothermal heating.
The terminal covers 23,800 sq. m., handles 35 lakh passengers annually, and aims to improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon footprint.

alert_news.title: India’s First U23 Greco‑Roman Silver Medal Won by Vishvajit More
bullets: Vishvajit More secured India’s first U23 Greco‑Roman silver medal at the World Wrestling Championships in Las Vegas, 2026.
First Indian wrestler to win a Greco‑Roman silver at the U23 level.
Medal contributed to India’s first medal at the 2026 U23 Championships.

alert_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Rs 3350 Crore Development Projects in Ladakh
bullets: India’s first airport terminal equipped with geothermal heating and solar power systems at Leh Airport, costing ₹650 crore and expanding annual passenger capacity from 10 lakh to 35 lakh
India’s first dedicated Petroglyph Conservation Park inaugurated in Leh to protect prehistoric rock art

alert_news.title: Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train: 371 Km Of Viaduct Completed, Over 9,300 OHE Masts Installed
bullets: India’s first bullet train corridor – the 508‑km Mumbai–Ahmedabad high‑speed rail – being built by NHSRCL, expected to be operational by 2029
371 km of viaduct and 9,300 overhead equipment masts installed, marking significant progress toward the 320‑kmph operational speed

alert_news.title: ARAI becomes India's first test agency to offer integrated vehicle cybersecurity services
bullets: India’s first test agency to provide integrated vehicle cybersecurity testing, verification, validation, R&D and homologation under one roof at ARAI
Facility supports compliance with AIS‑189 (Cyber Security Management Systems) and AIS‑190 (Software Update Management Systems), and offers VAPT, TARA, HSM, SSM, and CVE tracking

alert_news.title: India’s First Petroglyph Conservation Park Launched in Ladakh
bullets: India’s first petroglyph conservation park established in Ladakh as part of the ₹3,350 crore development projects launched by PM Modi
The park preserves ancient rock art and cultural heritage of the region
